privacy.title: Privacy Policy — Ruba Alghamdi
privacy.main:
Privacy Policy

Implementation note: This packaged site is configured for Netlify hosting and Netlify Forms, but it has not been deployed from this environment. Before publication, the deployed host and form processor must match this policy.

Who is responsible for this site?

This portfolio is operated by Ruba Alghamdi. Privacy questions or requests can be sent to rub.gmd23@gmail.com.

What the contact form collects

The form asks for name, email address, project type, message and an explicit consent checkbox. It does not ask for a phone number, physical address, budget or location.

Why the information is used

Contact-form information is used to receive, review and respond to an inquiry, and to protect the form against abuse. It is not used for advertising profiles or sold to advertisers.

Form processing and hosting

The included production configuration uses Netlify Forms. When deployed that way, contact submissions are transmitted to and stored by Netlify so they can be delivered to the site owner. Hosting infrastructure may also process technical request information such as IP address, user agent, timestamps and security logs as part of operating and protecting the service.

Retention

The website code does not create a separate contact database. Form submissions remain subject to the retention and deletion controls of the configured form processor. Ruba should delete inquiries when they are no longer reasonably needed for the conversation, an active engagement, record-keeping obligations or dispute handling.

Cookies and analytics

The site code contains no advertising trackers, analytics scripts, social-media embeds or non-essential cookie code. See the Cookie Policy for the configured behavior.

Your requests

You may contact Ruba to ask about personal data submitted through this site and, where applicable, request access, correction or deletion. Applicable rights depend on the relevant law and circumstances.

Saudi privacy framework

Saudi Arabia’s Personal Data Protection Law and implementing framework may apply depending on the processing and circumstances. This policy is written to disclose the data actually collected by this build and does not claim that the site has received a formal legal-compliance certification or legal review.

Changes

If hosting, analytics, embeds, payment, form processing or data practices change, this policy must be reviewed before those changes go live. Last updated: 6 September 2026.

Public note wall

Messages and optional names posted to the note wall are visible to everyone. Do not include private or sensitive information. Notes are stored with their creation time using Netlify Blobs until removed by the wall administrator. Requests to the wall are subject to platform rate limiting.

For removal requests, email rub.gmd23@gmail.com.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions — Ruba Alghamdi
terms.main:
Terms & Conditions

Purpose of the site

This website presents Ruba Alghamdi’s portfolio, project work and professional contact information. Browsing the site or submitting an inquiry does not by itself create a client relationship, contract or promise of availability.

Portfolio material

Project screens, case-study text and original presentation material are shown for portfolio purposes. Third-party names, marks, interface elements or platform references remain the property of their respective owners where applicable.

Accuracy

The site is intended to describe work accurately and avoids unverified client claims, testimonials and performance metrics. Project descriptions may be updated as the portfolio changes.

External links

The site links to services such as LinkedIn, GitHub and Figma. Those sites operate under their own terms and privacy practices. An external link is not an endorsement of every statement or practice on the linked service.

No on-site sale

The website does not provide checkout, accept payment or conclude a paid service contract through the website itself. Any freelance engagement agreed separately is governed by the proposal or contract for that engagement and applicable law.

Liability

The website is provided for portfolio and communication purposes. Nothing in these terms is intended to exclude rights or responsibilities that cannot lawfully be excluded under applicable law.

Contact

Questions about these terms can be sent to rub.gmd23@gmail.com. Last updated: 6 September 2026.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy — Ruba Alghamdi
cookies.main:
Cookie Policy

Configured behavior

This site’s own code does not set analytics cookies, advertising cookies, personalization cookies or tracking identifiers. It includes no Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, advertising SDK, fingerprinting code, social-media embeds or video embeds.

Why there is no cookie banner

Because this build does not load non-essential tracking or advertising technology, it intentionally does not display an ornamental consent banner. A banner should only be added if the deployed site actually introduces technology that requires a consent choice.

Hosting and security

The production package is configured for Netlify. Hosting and security infrastructure may use strictly necessary technical mechanisms to deliver and protect the site. Those mechanisms should be re-checked against the deployed host’s current documentation before publication.

If the setup changes

If analytics, advertising, embedded media or another non-essential technology is added, the site must first review whether consent is required, update this policy and block applicable scripts until the user has made the required choice. Last updated: 6 September 2026.

refund-policy.title: Refund Policy — Ruba Alghamdi
refund-policy.main:
Refund Policy

No checkout or payment on this website

This portfolio currently does not sell products, take deposits, accept payment or conclude a paid service contract through the website. As a result, there is no website purchase to refund through this site.

Separately agreed freelance work

If a project is agreed outside this website, payment, cancellation and refund terms should be stated in the specific proposal or contract for that engagement, subject to applicable law. This page does not override statutory consumer rights.

If direct sales are added later

A checkout, paid booking or direct electronic service sale must not be launched under this policy without first adding the actual price, contracting, cancellation and refund rules required for that transaction and checking the relevant legal obligations.

Contact

For a question about a separately agreed project, contact rub.gmd23@gmail.com. Last updated: 6 September 2026.

sources.title: Sources & Credits — Ruba Alghamdi
sources.main:
Sources & Credits

Portfolio content

Project names, descriptions, roles, tools, deliverables and prototype links are based on Ruba Alghamdi’s existing portfolio material and project files. The primary public reference is rubalghamdi.com.

Project visuals

Budgie and Gareeb imagery in this build comes from Ruba-provided portfolio/project assets. Qamareya and Day Diamond use original CSS editorial artwork on the portfolio shell rather than fabricated product screenshots. No stock portraits or AI-generated human imagery are included.

External project links

Figma prototype links are supplied on the relevant case-study pages. LinkedIn and GitHub URLs are taken from the existing portfolio.

Legal references

Privacy wording was reviewed against official guidance and the Personal Data Protection Law materials published by the Saudi Data & AI Authority (SDAIA): SDAIA Personal Data Protection knowledge center. E-commerce launch considerations were checked against the Saudi Ministry of Commerce e-commerce materials: E-Commerce System resources.

Licensing gate

Before public deployment, Ruba should confirm that every project image included in the final deployed build is hers to publish or is otherwise licensed for portfolio display. This package intentionally excludes unrelated stock imagery and AI-generated people.
